get.summary: List accounts belonging to a child

key.description: The key of the account. Used for further requests towards the account API

name.description: The default name set by the system

type.description:
The account type. Possible values:
        - USER: Local currency deposit user account
        - SAVING: Local currency deposit saving account
        - ANNLOAN: Annuity loan
        - BSU: Local currency deposit BSU account
        - CONTRACTGUAR: Contract guarantee
        - ELS: Currency deposit loan account
        - FIANNLOAN: Fixed interest annuity loan
        - FISERLOAN: Fixed interest serial loan
        - IFRS: Local currency IFRS account
        - LOANGUAR: Loan guarantee
        - LTO: Loan under long term surveillance
        - OTHERGUAR: Other guarantee
        - PAYGUAR: Payment guarantee
        - PENSION: Pension account
        - SAVEAGREE: Local currency savings agreement account
        - SECGUAR: Security guarantee
        - SERLOAN: Serial loan
        - STOCKSAVING: Local currency savings agreement account
        - TAXGUAR: Tax guarantee
        - TAXWITHDRAW: Local currency tax withdrawal account
        - YEARINTBONUS: Local currency deposit yearly interest bonus account
        - CREDITCARD: Credit card
        - UNKNOWN: Unknown host value

balance.description: The booked balance of the account, in the monetary unit represented by the currency code. The format is the monetary unit followed by . and two digits of cent. The value of cent in this context is one hundredth of the monetary unit. 12.67 in NOK would equal 12 kroners and 67 ore

productType.description:
The product code for the account. Possible values:
        - LOCDEPOSIT: Local currency deposit.
        - CURDEPOSIT: Currency deposit.
        - LOCLOAN: Local currency loan.
        - GUARANTEE: Guarantee.
        - UNKNOWN: Unknown host value.

descriptionCode.description: The description code for the account type

availableBalance.description: The available balance of the account, in the monetary unit represented by the currency code. The format is the monetary unit followed by . and two digits of cent. The value of cent in this context is one hundredth of the monetary unit. 12.67 in NOK would equal 12 kroners and 67 ore

type.description: If the customer is an organisation or personal customer

ssnKey.description: The customer's social security number encrypted. A different value will be generated for each call.

organisationNumber.description: The customer's org number, might be 9 digits or 11 digits if it's left padded with two zeroes

isHidden.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS FALSE - The account should be hidden in user interfaces

hasAccess.description: The user has access to the account

isBlocked.description: Access to the account has been blocked

isFlexiLoan.description: The account is a flexiloan account

isBonusAccount.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS FALSE - The account is a bonus account

isCodebitorLoan.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS FALSE - The account is a codebitor loan

isSavingsAccount.description: The account is a savings account

isAksjesparekonto.description: The account is a share savings account

isSecurityBalance.description: The account is a security balance

isTransferToEnabled.description: Transfers to the account is enabled

isPaymentFromEnabled.description: Payments from the account is enabled

isWithdrawalsAllowed.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS TRUE - Withdrawals from the account are allowed

userHasRightOfAccess.description: User has right of access to the

isAllowedInAvtaleGiro.description: Is allowed as debit account in AvtaleGiro agreements

isTransferFromEnabled.description: Transfers from the account is enabled

userHasRightOfDisposal.description: User has right of disposable for the account

isDefaultPaymentAccount.description: The account is the users preferred default payment account

isBalanceUpdatedImmediatelyOnTransferTo.description: If true, the account balance is updated immediately when transferring money to the account. If false, the balance will normally be updated within a few hours or days depending on the account type
